resources.string: Pause Mika so your bank app opens

Banking apps block Mika while its accessibility service or wireless debugging is on. Banking mode turns both off and stops the phone helper. Nothing is uninstalled, nothing is deleted, and the wireless-debugging pairing stays saved.
Accessibility off, helper disconnected. HSBC should now open.
Accessibility and the helper are running. Turn on Banking mode before opening your bank app.
Turn off accessibility and wireless debugging, stop the helper
Reconnect the helper using the saved pairing

Android does not let an app turn its own accessibility service back on. After resuming, open Accessibility settings and turn Mika back on yourself. No new pairing code is needed: the helper reconnects with the pairing that is already saved.
A running task was stopped first.
Could not turn the accessibility service off from here. Open Accessibility settings and turn Mika off.
Could not turn wireless debugging off from here. Open Developer options and turn it off.
Turn Mika back on in Accessibility settings
